title: The open tensor projection transpose is invertible
statement: For the ordinary or vertical operation data o and derived inputs M and N, the adjoint transpose of the normalized tensor comparison, namely the map from tensorU (M, j* N) transported by the open adjunction unit and tensor comparison to tensorX (j! M, N), is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 0GL1, lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor; sites-modules.tex Tag 0E8I; derived resolving-class transport by Tags 06YS and 06YU.

proof.text: Choose K-flat resolutions with flat terms for both derived inputs. Apply the underived slice extension/tensor formula termwise, and use exactness of restriction and extension plus preservation of colimits to assemble an isomorphism of total complexes.

Transport the comparison through the ringed-site derived tensor descent and the pullback preservation of K-flat complexes, including the vertical diagram-site realization for arbitrary semilinear coefficient transitions.

Identify the resulting comparison with the displayed tensor-model comparison and transpose it along the open extension/restriction adjunction. The representative map is invertible, so its adjoint transpose is the required isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0GL1 and sites-modules.tex Tag 0E8I, expanded through the K-flat resolving-class argument and the vertical diagram-site construction.

theorem tensor_open_extension_comparison_isIso {m : Mode} {d : Input.{u} m} {t : SiteSquare d}
    (o : Operations d t) (M : Der (restrictRing m d.j d.R)) (N : Der d.R) :
    IsIso ((o.opens.adj.homEquiv
      (o.tensorU.functor.obj (M, o.opens.jStar.obj N))
      (o.tensorX.functor.obj (o.opens.jShriek.obj M, N))).symm
      (o.tensorU.functor.map (CategoryTheory.Prod.mkHom
        (o.opens.adj.unit.app M) (𝟙 _)) ≫
        o.tensorComparison.comparison.inv.app (o.opens.jShriek.obj M, N)))
